title: Double-ended queue: compare from both ends
summary: Use a deque to test a stream of tokens for symmetry. Each comparison removes one token from each end.
triggers: consume a sequence from either end
compare the first and last remaining tokens
prompts: Does a sequence of station calls read the same on the return trip?
Check whether a list of drum hits is symmetric around its midpoint.
invariant: All pairs outside the deque have matched.
pitfalls: Stop when fewer than two tokens remain so the center is never paired with itself.

anchors.name: Valid Palindrome
anchors.trick: Normalize the tokens before comparing opposite ends.

mutations.explanation: Pairs adjacent tokens instead of opposite ends.

test: assert symmetric('abba') and symmetric('') and symmetric(['x'])
